tagline: Share pages with Discord communities and capture decisions in Notion
metaTitle: Notion Discord Integration: Announce Pages, Save Decisions
metaDescription: Keep your community current and decisions on record. GAIA announces new Notion pages in Discord and saves key threads to Notion. See the setup steps.
intro:
Communities and teams that build their knowledge base in Notion and their conversations in Discord face a familiar problem: important decisions, announcements, and resources get trapped on one side and never reach the people on the other. A major update gets published as a page but community members never see it unless someone manually shares the link. A critical decision made in a discussion thread is lost to history because no one took the time to document it in the knowledge base.

GAIA bridges the two to create a continuous flow of information between your knowledge base and your community. When a page is published or updated, GAIA can post a formatted announcement to the relevant channel so your community always knows about new content. When an important decision is made in a thread, GAIA can capture it in a Notion database so it is documented, searchable, and accessible to people who were not in the conversation.

This integration is ideal for source-available communities, DAOs, creator communities, and developer ecosystems that maintain public documentation in the knowledge base while running their real-time community in Discord. It is also valuable for internal teams that use the server as their chat platform but need to maintain a permanent knowledge base.

useCases.title: Auto-announce Notion page publications in Discord
useCases.description: When a page is published or moved to a published state, GAIA posts an announcement to the designated channel with the page title, a brief summary, and the link so community members are immediately informed about new content.

useCases.title: Capture important Discord decisions in Notion
useCases.description: When a conversation is marked with a specific emoji reaction or a moderator uses a slash command, GAIA extracts the thread context and creates a structured page documenting the decision, participants, date, and any relevant links.

useCases.title: Sync page announcements to multiple servers
useCases.description: For communities with multiple servers or channels for different audiences, GAIA can route page updates to the most relevant destination based on tags, categories, or explicit routing rules defined in GAIA.

useCases.title: Create FAQ entries from Q&A threads
useCases.description: GAIA monitors channels designated for Q&A and automatically exports resolved question threads to an FAQ database, building your knowledge base from real community questions without any manual documentation effort.

useCases.title: Post a weekly digest of new pages
useCases.description: GAIA compiles a weekly digest of new and updated pages and posts a structured summary to the server every week so community members who miss individual announcements get a regular catch-up of everything new in the knowledge base.

howItWorks.step: Connect Notion and Discord to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Notion workspace and Discord server in GAIA's integration settings. Configure which databases and pages GAIA should monitor and which channels should receive announcements or capture triggers.

howItWorks.step: Set up your announcement and capture rules
howItWorks.description: Tell GAIA which types of page updates should post to channels, what the announcement format should look like, and how messages or reactions should trigger captures. You can set rules per-channel, per-database, or globally.

howItWorks.step: GAIA moves information both ways automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both platforms for configured triggers and executes announcements and captures in real time. Your community stays informed about knowledge base updates, and important discussions always end up documented.

faqs.question: Can GAIA capture entire Discord threads, or just individual messages?
faqs.answer: GAIA can capture full threads as a single page, including all replies, timestamps, and participant names. For long threads, GAIA provides a summary at the top followed by the full transcript, making the captured content useful even without reading every message.

faqs.question: Can GAIA post page updates to multiple channels simultaneously?
faqs.answer: Yes. A single page update can trigger posts to multiple channels if configured. You can also set up routing rules where a page tagged 'announcement' goes to a public channel while pages tagged 'internal' route only to a private staff channel.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require bot permissions on the server to function?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA uses a bot with message send, read message history, and reaction access permissions. These are standard permissions that can be granted without admin access and can be scoped to specific channels if your server uses channel-level permission overrides.
